notes.title: Game Release Imminent!
notes.notes:
Hello! This is ohkapi, a solo developer of interactive movies.  
After my previous project, FMV **MoteSolo: No Girlfriend Since Birth**, I’m excited to introduce my latest work.

**Simp: Leveling Up on a Dating App**

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248035/775214bbdf7459ffecd96aadc66b3cc451e99cec.png

This is the story of Tesu, a simp who’s never been in a relationship, diving headfirst into the wild world of dating apps. Starting as a Bronze-tier simp, he’s determined to climb to Gold tier, learning how to survive in this competitive jungle along the way.  

His daily life has been on repeat for years—work, home, sleep. The years keep passing, but he’s still single. The thought of staying alone forever quietly nags at him, but he’s always too tired after work to try anything new. Even the idea of a blind date feels impossible, especially since he has no friends left to set him up.  
"Is this really it? Will I live the rest of my life alone…?"  
Just when it feels like all hope is lost, a new possibility catches his eye: Dating App.
"What if this is my chance? Could I meet someone here? Should I at least try before it’s too late…?"  
[spoiler] But of course, this story is not based on true events. It is purely the story of a simp. [/spoiler]

While dating apps make it easy to meet people quickly, they also demand you showcase your charm in seconds. Can Tesu, with your advice, learn to stand out and level up his dating tier?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248035/a60091ac35d8dcd3e0a9885b32a6f6c4740b6fbf.png

Since this is a solo-developed project, I couldn’t include entire story of simp this time. But I hope to explore the rest in future projects. Stay tuned for updates on releases, discounts, and other announcements through the Steam Community. Don’t forget to wishlist and follow the game to stay up to date! Your support means everything.

**Simp: Leveling Up on a Dating App**  
Not everyone’s story… purely a simp’s story.
Launching January 31, 2025.  

Thank you!
